reviews.title: AMF XML and sparse arrays with explicit complex-type limits
reviews.summary: Native SOL exchange now has independent fixtures and browser file/reload coverage. ByteArray object records support XML and sparse indices, but Vector, Dictionary and IExternalizable remain unsupported; readObject/writeObject are corrected to Partial rather than implying complete AMF type coverage.

entries.note: Reads bounded AMF0/AMF3 graphs with aliases, shared/cyclic references, sparse indices, Date, ByteArray and XML/XMLDocument. AMF3 Vector, Dictionary and IExternalizable payloads remain unsupported.

Writes bounded AMF0/AMF3 graphs with aliases, shared/cyclic references, sparse indices, Date, ByteArray and XML/XMLDocument. AMF3 Vector, Dictionary and IExternalizable serialization remain unsupported.
